# Configuring P-CSCF IPv6 Address in PDN Message (2025-09-15 09:23Z)

_**User (2025-09-15 09:41Z)**_

@workspace How to setup P-CSCF? so that the PDN accept message will contains "P-CSCF IPV6 Address"

---

_**Assistant (copilot/gemini-2.5-pro)**_

To have the P-CSCF IPv6 address included in the PDN connection accept message, you need to configure the IPv6 addresses of your P-CSCF(s) in the SMF configuration file. The SMF will then include one of these addresses in the Protocol Configuration Options (PCO) of the NAS `ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST` message sent to the UE.

Here is an example of how to configure P-CSCF addresses in your SMF configuration file (e.g., `install/etc/open5gs/smf.yaml`):

````yaml
# ...existing code...
smf:
  # ...existing code...
  p-cscf:
    - 2001:db8:a0b:12f0::1
    - 192.0.2.1
  # ...existing code...
````

The SMF parses this configuration in `smf_context_parse`. It identifies whether each entry is an IPv4 or IPv6 address and stores them in separate lists, `p_cscf` for IPv4 and `p_cscf6` for IPv6, within the `smf_context_t` structure defined in `context.h`.

When a UE requests a PDN connection for IMS, the SMF builds the PCO. If the UE has been assigned an IPv6 address for the PDU session, the SMF will select a P-CSCF IPv6 address from the configured `p_cscf6` list and add it to the PCO as the "P-CSCF IPv6 Address". This logic is handled when building the PCO for the `ACTIVATE_DEFAULT_EPS_BEARER_CONTEXT_REQUEST` message.
